limitations: Q1 2026 filing-date batch, not necessarily fiscal Q1 facts or all historical filings. Issuer count is separate from other batches and not added without deduplication.

Values retain accession, taxonomy version, period, duration in quarters, units, segments, co-registrants, footnotes and presentation context. Repeated periods and amendments are not silently consolidated.
Numeric rows are not unique comparable facts. No automatic quarter-over-quarter growth, financial totals, signals or recommendations are inferred.
Missing taxonomy definitions, if present, remain explicitly flagged and unqualified, never dropped or invented.
All four source tables are retained privately. Only aggregate coverage is public; no source values or private addresses are published.
Exact browser status/download clock unavailable; local verification time is not first-public or prospective decision evidence. No orders, historical decisions or simulated fills.
